instruction: In rust-lang/rust pull requests, use the visible search/filter UI to find open non-draft pull requests with the A-compiler label and sort them by recently updated. Inspect the first two results. For each report number, title, author, last-updated date, labels, changed-file count, additions, deletions, and whether a test file is included. Then rank the two by changed-file count. Do not sign in, review, comment, merge, close, or otherwise modify pull requests.
